structured_output.summary: The change replaces the stub with a thin wrapper. It passes `this`, `byteOffset`, `littleEndian`, `ElementType::BigUint64` and `value` to the existing `set_view_value` helper, propagates errors with `?`, and returns undefined. That matches the spec's three steps. I only read the diff, so the helper's own conformance is unchecked. The gate shows the 4 target tests passing with no regressions. One small point: the extra "if littleEndian is not present, set it to false" step isn't in the spec text. It behaves the same as passing undefined, because `SetViewValue` applies ToBoolean to the flag, so I did not count it as a defect.
